apiBoundaries.detail: Each package uses conditional exports: .: { types: ./dist/index.d.ts, import: ./dist/index.js }. Consumers import @heynxt/xxx, never @heynxt/xxx/src/ or dist/.
All inter-package types flow through Zod schemas in core-types. Persistence table columns map 1:1 via camelCase convention.
No HTTP routes exist yet. Phase 1.6 will add Next.js API routes in apps/web/src/app/api/*. The persistence package will export a configured db client.
Drizzle-kit owns the migrations/ folder. Migrations are additive SQL; never hand-edit generated SQL files.
No tool like manypkg yet enforcing no-internal-path. Convention via CLAUDE.md only.

loadBearingFiles.reason: Single source of truth for all cross-package types. Adding a schema here cascades to prompt-spec, agent-adapter, blueprint-registry, domain-models, persistence, web. Removing or renaming a schema here is a breaking change.
9 schema files, each is a boundary contract for the corresponding persistence table + any downstream consumer. Editing these requires matching Drizzle table updates.
Barrel re-export; drizzle-kit schema entry. Adding/removing a table here requires running db:migrate:generate.
9 files, each in 1:1 mapping with a core-types schema. Editing requires matching Zod schema edit + re-generating migration.
drizzle-kit config; schema entry is dist/schema/index.js (compiled). Changing this breaks migration generation.
First migration (idempotent). Already committed. Future changes must be additive migrations, never in-place edit.
Local Postgres 15 (mirrors Neon). Credentials heynxt/heynxt/heynxt must match DATABASE_URL in .env.
Base TS compiler options inherited by all 7 packages. strict mode, module/target selection, ESM config. Any change cascades everywhere.
Defines which directories are workspace members. Adding a package requires editing this.
Turbo task pipeline rules (build, dev, lint, typecheck, test, clean). Changing alters every package build behavior.
Workspace scripts dev:db / db:migrate / etc. Engine constraints (pnpm>=9, node>=20). Dev deps (turbo, typescript).
Session guide for all Claude Code work in this repo. Rules, phases, package boundaries, hard rules. Editing changes session behavior for every future session.

uncertainOrInferred.detail: packages/persistence exports the 9 tables but no configured db client. Phase 1.6 will add packages/persistence/src/client.ts. The apps/web routes will then depend on persistence for the first time.

uncertainOrInferred.detail: Real Next.js routes (layout.tsx, page.tsx, app/api/) are deferred to Phase 6. Until then the web package cannot actually serve HTTP.

uncertainOrInferred.subject: graphify reports for the 3 reference repos are stale
uncertainOrInferred.detail: Coding-agent-template, FactoryNXT_PY_V2, FactoryNXT_PY_V2_Extrusion graphs under graphify/ were generated pre-Phase-0. Not refreshed this session (user only asked for heynxt-core). Re-run Graphify when Phase 3 (blueprint extraction) starts.

uncertainOrInferred.subject: No lint enforcement for cross-package imports
uncertainOrInferred.detail: CLAUDE.md forbids internal-path imports (e.g. @heynxt/xxx/src/anything) but no manypkg / ESLint rule enforces it. Violation risk grows as the dep graph widens.

uncertainOrInferred.subject: Test coverage for persistence package is zero
uncertainOrInferred.detail: vitest.config.ts exists but no *.test.ts files in packages/persistence. Recommended: add round-trip tests that INSERT then SELECT via Zod.validate(), or use drizzle-kit in-memory SQLite for unit tests.

uncertainOrInferred.subject: role_assignments NULL-caveat on composite UNIQUE
uncertainOrInferred.detail: Postgres treats NULLs as distinct in UNIQUE constraints, so org-scoped (workspaceId=NULL) role assignments can collide. Mitigated at the API layer via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT, but worth noting.
